page.l: vno volumine comprehensa Lectori exhibens; idque
PRIOR disciplinas Instrumentales siue Propaedeuticas vna cum Tractatibus ad eas pertinentibus completitur.

POSTERIOR ipsam Pacdian Philosophicam siue Scientias & Prudentias Philosophicas ipsas conuenienti ordine continet vna cum adiunctis disputationibus & commentationibus, quibus vna vel altera Systematis alicuius Pars & Materia ab Autore fuit illustrata.
Cum Indice triplici, librorum, capitum, rerum & verborum.
[engraving: oval emblem with figure of a man on a rocky path under a tree and a bird, banner inscriptions ESTVIA, IN VIA, ALTA, ILLVSTRA]
page.notes: The woodcut emblem's banner letters are only partly legible and were not fully read. The small "R" in the left margin is a handwritten mark, not printed, and is omitted. The imprint line "MDCXIII." is printed as a Roman numeral in the scan. No page number or running head is printed.
